description: Core grammar types for Chuukese dictionary - pure grammatical categories without modifiers
note: These are the fundamental parts of speech. All modifiers (transitive, locational, reduplicated, etc.) will be stored in grammar_modifier field.

core_types.name: adjective
core_types.description: A word that describes or modifies a noun

core_types.name: adverb
core_types.description: A word that modifies a verb, adjective, or other adverb

core_types.name: article
core_types.description: A word that defines a noun as specific or unspecific

core_types.name: auxiliary
core_types.description: A helping verb used with main verbs

core_types.name: classifier
core_types.description: A word used to count or classify nouns

core_types.name: conjunction
core_types.description: A word that connects clauses or sentences

core_types.name: demonstrative
core_types.description: A word that points to specific things

core_types.name: idiom
core_types.description: A phrase with a meaning different from literal interpretation

core_types.name: interjection
core_types.description: An exclamation or sudden remark

core_types.name: interrogative
core_types.description: A word used to ask questions

core_types.name: noun
core_types.description: A word that represents a person, place, thing, or idea

core_types.name: number
core_types.description: Numerical value (cardinal or ordinal)

core_types.name: numeral
core_types.description: A word representing a number

core_types.name: particle
core_types.description: A functional word that expresses grammatical relationships

core_types.name: possessive
core_types.description: Indicates ownership or possession

core_types.name: preposition
core_types.description: A word that shows relationship between nouns/pronouns and other words

core_types.name: prefix
core_types.description: A word element attached to the beginning of a word

core_types.name: pronoun
core_types.description: A word that substitutes for a noun

core_types.name: quantifier
core_types.description: A word that expresses quantity

core_types.name: suffix
core_types.description: A word element attached to the end of a word

core_types.name: verb
core_types.description: A word that describes an action, state, or occurrence
